description: This line plot illustrates the loss values across iterations for six different model configurations, comparing their training performance. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot contains six distinct lines: a purple line for "Vanilla", a blue line for "StrmLLM (n=64)", an orange line for "SepLLM (n=64)", a green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)", a red line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", and a dark blue line for "SepLLM (n=128)". All lines start at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid decline in loss during the initial iterations, followed by a gradual flattening as they approach a stable loss value near 2.5 after approximately 100,000 iterations. The "Vanilla" model starts at a loss of 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.6. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5.
